page.overview:
Who is Injured doctor?

An unnamed doctor was a minor character in . He was a member of the Cult of Thorn.

The only appearance of this doctor is after his other co-workers are killed. The doctor, although injured, manages to run out of the room and down a corridor after Tommy Doyle, Kara Strode, her son Danny and baby Steven. However, Michael Myers chases after him.

After running for several more paces, Tommy shuts and locks a gate in front of the doctor, who, with no means of escape, is killed when Michael catches up to him and crushes his head between the gate and his own bare hands with enough force to break the gate down.
